input.text: In Kansas branches, resolve complaints within 30 business days of receipt, or tell the customer when to expect a resolution.

input.text: Escalate any complaint alleging unfair treatment to management on the day it is received.

input.text: Resolve complaints within 15 days of receipt, or tell the customer when to expect a resolution.
